findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
There are two ice bins in the facility, on in the bar and one downstairs.  Both machines contain mold in mildew.  Discussed with a member of the club.  Ensure ice bins are cleaned and sanitized.

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Test strips were not located in the facility for the sanitizer tablets in the kitchen.  Quarternary sanitizer tablets are on-site, although no test strips are available. Ensure the appropriate test strips are obtained to measure the concentration of sanitizer.

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Numerous ceiling tiles are missing in the basement.  Discussed with the member present.  Ensure the ceiling tiles are replaced.

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the ice deflector shield at the ice machine to be soiled with what appears to be slime and mold. Clean the ice deflector shield inside the ice machine.
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
1). Observed the microwave downstairs to be soiled with food debris. 2). Observed the oven on the left (white) to be soiled with food splash and debris. Clean all non-food contact surfaces.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
1). Observed no soap and paper towel at the bar hand sink. Provide soap and paper towel at the bar hand sink. Paper towel and soap was provided at the bar hand sink during the inspection to correct the violation. 2). Observed no covered waste cans in the women restroom. Provide covered waste cans in the women restroom.
750-1120e A supply of soap and and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.
750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the mini pizza freezer to have ice build up. Defrost the mini pizza freezer.
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
1). Observed single service plates in the dry storage to have the food contact surface exposed. Store the single service plates to prevent contamination.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment:
CORRECTED: Observed a mop bucket in the kitchen full with waste water. Empty all waste water when not in use. The waste water was emptied during the inspection to correct the violation.
750-1130(e) Liquid waste from compacting or cleaning operations shall be disposed of as sewage.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment:
Observed dead crickets, roaches, mouse droppings, cinapedes, and spiders on the floor near dishes. The facility has Sentinel for Pest control. The pest control have not been in the facility for the month of December.
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
Observed the kitchen door in the basement to have daylight and gaps. Provide a weather strip on the door to prevent rodents. 
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
CORRECTED: Observed the mop head to be stored in waste water. Store the mop head to air dry to prevent rodents. The mop head was properly stored during the inspection to correct the violation. 
750-1160 The premises shall be kept in such a condition to prevent the harborage or feeding of insects or rodents.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed two raw wood surfaces behind the men's urinals. Paint or seal raw wood surfaces to make for a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed slight mold growth on pipe where water is dispensed inside the ice machine. Remove ice and wash, rinse, and sanitize this food contact surface.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: .140) no thermometers in pizza freezer, bar cooler with drink mixers, coolers and freezers downstairs.  Replace them.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: .800) mold inside ice machine.  Clean and sanitize.
